_meta.description: Press-your-luck trivia for iPhone & iPad: win the trivia race, then flip cards to bank points — but don't draw a Zap. Duel friends over Game Center or right inside iMessage. 21 categories, 5,000+ questions, updated over the air.
a-more-flexible-ipad.4f5465: A more flexible iPad experience and a round of polish
answer-correctly-and-you.298785: Answer correctly and you earn a draw from a shared 3×3 grid. Flip cards to bank 1, 2, or 3 points — keep going or lock your pot. But two Zaps are hiding, and one bust wipes the round.
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
both-players-get-the.42ba59: Both players get the same questions and the same shuffled card grid — so every duel comes down to speed, smarts, and nerve.
branding-by-marty-buck.24746a: Branding by Marty Buck · Sound design & original inspiration by Austin Buck · Development & music by Blaine Miller
correct-answers-earn-points.a4fb6f: Correct answers earn points based on the question's difficulty plus a speed bonus that decays as the clock runs. Answer instantly for the full bonus; wrong or timed-out answers score zero.
do-i-need-to.f0745d: Do I need to be online? ▼
electric-branding-live-duels.b6adc4: Electric branding, live duels, color-coded categories
general-knowledge-science-history.566f02: General Knowledge, Science, History, Geography, Film & TV, Music, Sports, Video Games, Anime, Bible, and more — over 5,000 questions in all.
how-do-new-questions.e084c8: How do new questions arrive? ▼
ipad-any-way-you.3a62ad: iPad, Any Way You Hold It
live-head-to-head.9f4954: Live head-to-head and async turn-based duels with friends or random opponents, plus Most Wins, Solo High Score, Biggest Round, and Lucky Streak leaderboards and 12 achievements.
no-tracking-no-ads.9ce4d2: No tracking. No ads. No in-app purchases.
no-zap-ships-with.b21075: No. Zap ships with a full offline question set, so Solo and Pass N' Play work anywhere. Online and iMessage duels need a connection, and new questions download in the background when you're online.
one-device-two-players.e8ebac: One device, two players, a privacy handoff screen between turns. Perfect for the couch or a road trip.
over-the-air-questions.fbc6fe: Over the air. Questions are curated and version-controlled, then delivered to the app automatically — so the library grows without waiting on an App Store release.
questions-update-over-the.6c5cfa: Questions update over the air from a curated, version-controlled source — new content lands without an App Store update.
race-to-answer-press.122a8c: Race to Answer. Press Your Luck.
some-trivia-questions-provided.7e3357: Some trivia questions provided by the Open Trivia Database, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.
speed-matters-every-answer.04f8af: Speed matters, every answer crackles, and your friends are one tap away
start-a-match-and.e3b0ec: Start a match and answer your turn right inside the conversation — one question per bubble. Send it, your friend answers, back and forth.
the-main-menu-s.a0aef6: The main menu’s spark field now re-spans whenever the window changes size, so the electricity fills the screen no matter how you arrange your workspace.
trivia-meets-blackjack-win.dea239: Trivia meets blackjack. Win the trivia race, then press your luck on a grid of cards — keep flipping to grow your pot or lock it in, but draw a Zap and you bust. Duel friends over Game Center or right inside an iMessage. 21 categories, 5,000+ questions, delivered fresh over the air.
yes-both-players-receive.49ac22: Yes. Both players receive the exact same questions in the same order, derived from a shared random seed — neither side can see the other's questions in advance, and an anti-tamper check guards iMessage matches.
zap-has-no-ads.92302a: Zap has no ads, no tracking, and no in-app purchases.
zap-resizes-freely-on.324217: Zap resizes freely on iPad — every orientation, Split View, Stage Manager, and iPad windowing all supported, with the menu falling back to scrolling in short windows so nothing ever clips.
